result.title: GlobalPuzzle: Globally Informed Genetic Search for Eroded Jigsaw Puzzle Reassembly
result.comment: 22 pages (10 pages main paper and 12 pages supplementary material), 16 figures
result.summary: Jigsaw puzzle reassembly remains a highly challenging task, particularly when piece boundaries are irregularly eroded to simulate damage to cultural artifacts. On the GAP benchmark, existing methods achieve a perfect assembly accuracy of only 0.3% on $5 \times 5$ puzzles, whereas humans can solve jigsaw puzzles with remarkably high accuracy. Humans typically approach puzzle solving by identifying potentially adjacent pieces, evaluating the current assembly, and iteratively performing complex operations such as adding pieces, replacing incorrectly placed pieces, and moving entire connected groups of pieces. However, existing methods face a fundamental limitation: approaches that leverage global visual information typically predict piece arrangements directly, making it difficult to explicitly perform such complex iterative operations, while search based methods can rearrange pieces but primarily rely on pairwise boundary compatibility, lacking global visual information to evaluate and guide the search process. To bridge this gap, we propose GlobalPuzzle, a jigsaw puzzle reassembly framework that integrates global canvas level evaluation, action guidance, and genetic search. By incorporating global visual information into the evaluation and optimization of candidate assemblies, GlobalPuzzle aims to resolve ambiguous adjacency relationships that are difficult to determine from irregularly eroded piece boundaries alone, enabling flexible, globally informed reconstruction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GlobalPuzzle 框架，将全局画布级评估、动作引导与遗传搜索结合，用于边界被侵蚀的拼图重组，以缓解仅靠成对边界匹配难以判断的模糊邻接关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 用全局评估器对候选整体组装打分并指引搜索与迭代修改（替换、整组移动），可能为 LVR 中推理状态的全局评价、搜索验证与回退操作提供借鉴线索；但任务属纯视觉拼图，评分器能否迁移到 latent 状态评价尚需核查。
